why: `controlIdAt` is how an index becomes a name without the number reaching a player. Answering the profile's first control for every index would name every button A / Cross, and would give the D-pad a control id it does not have.
killedBy: controlIdAt (issue #754) names the control at every standard bindable index, the reverse of the list it reads
controlIdAt (issue #754) names nothing where the profile lists no bindable control: the D-pad, Home, or a bare profile
